rasterOfficerLimits: We read retained originals up to16MiB, with at most100million pixels and1-4 numeric bands of one sample type.
The upload request stays17MiB including its form;64 raster originals and256MiB total are held in this runtime.
A part is at most256x256 pixels,2MiB native samples,4MiB TIFF and32KiB receipt, with pixel starts<=100000.
Different masks or nodata per band and unsupported sample types stay refused without truncating the original.
At most32 window jobs per original and2 queued/running raster jobs; rest ends read_to_limit, kept but not read.
Native request100s,whole job150s,reads30s,lease180s,max3 fenced attempts and6MiB reader reply remain finite.
Probe remains64KiB head/tail with2s budget; metadata it misses can be cited from the first native read.
Browser previews remain below16million pixels, but decode one256 window at a time; no whole-file allocation.
Point/raster S3 retains connect5s/read30s with2 retries; no provider cost. Unsupported outcomes stay visible.
pointOfficerLimits: We read originals up to16MiB and5million points, compressed LAS1.4 format6,30-byte records without extras only.
The request stays17MiB;64 point originals and256MiB total are held, and at most2 point jobs run or wait together.
Each part has at most8192 points,512KiB native artifact and32KiB receipt; start/count must fit the source.
Replace32 historical jobs with611 unique planned parts per original, enough for the existing5million-point limit.
Each display preview is at most2048 cells/points and256KiB; thinning never alters native original or artifact.
Native request100s,job150s,read30s,lease180s,max3 attempts,731820B native reply remain finite.
Preview gets its own256KiB response; native731820B reply and720KiB base64 string caps do not grow.
Probe64KiB head/tail2s and S3 connect5s/read30s/retries2 stay; unread or failed parts remain visible and retained.
costAndDeferredWork: No provider charge/GPU. Estimate44 worker-hours (24 backend+12 map+8 drop); range36-56 for integration risk.
Smallest build keeps original16MiB native ceiling;2GB/1GB targets need a separate large-read build.
Each native part spools/hashes whole original:9 image,16 DEM,211 LAZ reads without a later snapshot cache.
11.1MB LAZ: about2.34GB source I/O;0.774s*211=163s is extrapolation, not measured whole-file time.
No COG pyramid, COPC octree traversal, scratch cache, GPU chips, height qualification or cards here.
The large transport still starts above16MiB: v1<=128MiB,v2<=7GiB,8MiB parts, existing quotas/deadlines stay.
Large originals can be retained but native reading stays denied; never silently upgrade profiles.
